name: qq-messages
title_zh: 本地只读QQ聊天记录，问一句就翻出原话
tagline_zh: 不登录网页版、不碰手机，直接搜本地QQNT消息。问“上周群里谁说了啥”它秒回原文，还能按群总结、看哪些对话还热着。
tagline_en: Skip web login & phone—search local QQNT history directly. Ask what was said last week, get verbatim quotes.
desc_en: 通过只读 qqnt-local MCP 读取、搜索、总结、回顾或监控用户本地 QQ/QQNT 消息和群聊。Use whenever the user asks what was said on QQ, requests recent QQ messages or a named-group summary, or asks which QQ conversations are active. Do not use for inspecting the QQ app interface or sending or modifying messages.
why_zh: 走只读MCP管道，绝不发送或改动消息。把QQ聊天变成可检索的个人档案，而不是另一个需要盯着的通知流。
why_en: Read-only MCP pipeline—zero send/modify risk. Turns QQ history into a queryable personal archive, not another notification feed.
limit_zh: 仅限macOS本地QQNT客户端已存的聊天记录；不覆盖手机/其他设备消息，不解析图片语音内容，不监控新消息实时推送。
limit_en: macOS local QQNT history only; no mobile/other-device msgs, no image/voice parsing, no real-time push alerts.
title_en: Read-only local QQ chat search & recall
